issues.what: The transformation never happens on screen. Across all 28 frames no rusty bridge is shown, nothing starts to glow and no tea terrace appears. After the camera settles at frame 004, frames 004-027 are pixel-identical apart from rain streaks and the water counter going 60->62 L. The whole 'reveal' is 24 frames of a static alley.
issues.where: Entire sequence; frames 004-027 are one static shot of the narrow balcony walkway with Gen-san's back at center
issues.fix: Frame the footbridge landing and play the change in view. Rust panels flake off, Gen-san's deck boards slide into place one after another, and lanterns light along the railing in a left-to-right wave until the terrace glows warm against the purple rain. Hold the final terrace in frame for at least 1.5 s before handing control back.

issues.what: The camera points the wrong way. The view runs down the cramped balcony corridor: a brown wall fills the right 40% of the frame, the black railing cuts across the lower left, and Gen-san's back blocks the middle. The bridge or landing the dialogue talks about is not in shot, and the waypoint at the bottom right says '8 m ↓', so the subject is somewhere off-screen.
issues.where: Right 40% (wall), lower-left foreground (railing and a yellow object clipping the bottom edge), center (Gen-san), bottom-right waypoint marker
issues.fix: For the reveal, take the camera with a scripted dolly or turn. Swing it left and out over the railing so the bridge landing fills the center two-thirds, with Gen-san off to one side as a silhouette and no wall in shot.

issues.what: The only signals that anything changed are UI. In frames 001-004 a toast reads 'A new section on the tea counter, for the new tea.', the yen counter ticks 199,923 -> 199,999 -> 200,000, and frame 004 adds a 'CHAPTER 3 Start the renovation at the holo-model table' quest banner. That is a menu or ledger update, not a reward the player sees in the world.
issues.where: Top-center toast and banner (frames 001-027), top-left yen counter (frames 000-002)
issues.fix: Hide the toast and quest banner until the in-world reveal has finished, then show one short, elegant title card such as 'Rooftop Tea Terrace'. Drop or delay the yen tick so it does not compete with the scene.

issues.what: The reveal is told rather than shown. Frame 000 is a block of narration ('Gen-san has decked a walkway onto it. Tomo has wheeled a yatai cart into the alley mouth...'), so the change is described as already done while the camera shows none of it.
issues.fix: Cut the narration down to a one-line setup, then show the decking, the yatai cart and the lights arriving on camera. Let Gen-san's line ('One more board...') cue the last board dropping into place in view.

issues.what: The dialogue is captured mid-typewriter. Frame 001 shows 'Gen-san / On' in a box that is otherwise empty, which looks broken.
issues.fix: Speed up the text reveal or skip ahead to the full line, and let the player tap to complete it. A single-word box should never sit on screen long enough to be captured.

issues.what: The UI layers overlap and clutter the moment. In frames 003-027 the controls hint ('Click to look around · WASD move · E use · Tab phone') covers Gen-san's name label ('Gen-san' is cut off at the top) and his shoulders. The interaction ring sits on his head, and up to three panels are stacked at center at once.
issues.where: Center of frame, y≈250-310; top-center banners at y≈80-125
issues.fix: Suppress the tutorial hint, the reticle and the NPC label during the reveal. Afterwards, put the controls hint in a bottom corner, clear of nameplates.

issues.what: The scene has no light or colour change at all. The palette stays the same cold purple and blue rain and dim brown wall from start to finish, so nothing 'glows'.
issues.where: Whole frame; compare 004 and 027, which are identical
issues.fix: Add a warm amber key light that ramps up on the terrace. Show the lantern bloom reflected in the wet surfaces and add rising tea steam, so the last frame reads clearly warmer than the first.

issues.what: There is a hard camera cut and jump between frames 002 and 003. The view shifts and widens, the dialogue box vanishes, and the HUD pops in all at once instead of easing.
issues.fix: Ease the camera from the dialogue framing to the reveal framing over about 0.5 s. Fade the HUD in only after the reveal finishes.

verdict: Nothing is revealed. This is a dialogue snippet, a currency tick and a quest-banner toast over 24 frames of an unchanged rainy corridor, with the bridge and terrace never in shot. A player will remember nothing, because nothing transforms in front of them. Rebuild it as a framed in-world sequence: bridge in view, rust to boards to warm lanterns, a hold on the glowing terrace, and UI only after that.
